content: Notion AI Q&A answers over workspace pages with citations back to the original blocks, restricted to chosen sources. Documented failure modes: cannot search or understand database relationships (project trackers, CRMs, content calendars are effectively ignored); cannot see inside embeds (embedded PDFs/Google Docs are invisible); poor at aggregation across many docs and at calculation. Works only when the question is specific and the source material plainly exists. Teams that try to make it the central knowledge hub 'hit big walls'. Lesson: coverage gaps that are invisible to the user destroy trust faster than wrong answers.
